text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp of our third year 
ended. Orfevre has reached yet another 
level of growth at this point—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Associate
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! With these numbers on this slope, 
the brutal elevation changes of 
ParisLongchamp shouldn't be a problem at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Associate
text_block_list.text:
Still, the level of perfection is 
astounding...! As of right now, I see no 
cause for concern whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: URA Affiliate
text_block_list.text:
Ah, is that day finally coming...? That 
dream, broken again and again... is it 
finally here?!

text_block_list.name: URA Affiliate
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, excuse me. Getting all excited on 
my own like that...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I care not. Such is the duty of the 
common folk."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Turn that frenzy into a song of triumph.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Affiliate
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, she doesn't feel any pressure at 
all. This is truly...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Affiliate
text_block_list.text:
Even those who have drifted away are sure 
to be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Affiliate
text_block_list.text:
You've trained quite an incredible 
Umamusume, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre is truly magnificent. That's 
precisely why that dream... weighs on me. 
The ending shown in that dream continues 
to haunt me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's dream has vanished right before 
the finish line...! Orfevre finishes in 
2nd place!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I kept having that dream all 
throughout summer camp. And... I just 
couldn't bring myself to dismiss it as 
nothing more than a dream.
choice_data_list:
(If I were to lose, the reason would 
be...)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: We're heading back. Get yourself ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished getting ready, as I tried 
to head back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, a quick word. Please ride with us 
on our bus on the way back!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: —No. First, just you alone.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I return with my sister. ...Report.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Let me get straight to the point.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer who had previously won the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe raised their hand to 
take on Orfevre's challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The name Chairwoman Akikawa uttered was 
that of a top-of-the-top, brilliant 
trainer everyone admires... one racing 
along the very front lines of the 
international racing world.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Ordinarily, she was supposed to accompany 
another promising Umamusume for the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe... but her schedule 
suddenly opened up, it seems."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Having long held close ties with Japan, he 
wondered if there was anything he could do 
for the country, which ultimately led him 
to Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“And drawn to the strength she possesses, 
they reached out to us.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, this is something to welcome 
with open arms. Having the support of a 
trainer who knows the world stage is 
reassuring. However, in that case—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In that case, though, he will be in 
charge. He'll likely be the one making all 
the big decisions.
choice_data_list:
In other words, at the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
You might end up having to stick to a 
supporting role. Though that depends on 
their decision.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Many Umamusume are seeking his services. 
I'm afraid you have almost no time to 
deliberate."
choice_data_list: Do I... have to make a decision right now?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Considering how far she's come, 
stepping down from the main roster must be 
a difficult decision.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, I felt I needed to present it as 
one of your options.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
There is no right answer. No one knows the 
future. Talk it through thoroughly with 
Orfevre, and decide.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No one knows the future"—yet, if that 
dream is a destined fate to come... I 
already know what awaits if I continue 
down this path.
choice_data_list:
(My heart is screaming—that is the 
future—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If that's the case... Then to change the 
future, a major decision must be made.
choice_data_list:
(There's absolutely no reason she should 
lose.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre is flawless. In that case, the one 
who must change is...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...If this is the final chance to change 
the future... —Shouldn't I take my hands 
off completely?"
choice_data_list:
(It's because of every step we've taken to 
get here—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in having built a solid 
foundation of trust with her. She might 
try to defer to my opinion as her 
sub-trainer... but that would defeat the 
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With my doubts still unresolved, I 
returned to the Trainer's Office, and...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Your report?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Cut the chatter.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Just make your choice. What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no way she could have known 
about this. Yet her eyes, fixed with 
unusual earnestness, seemed to see right 
through everything.
choice_data_list: Your victory is what matters most to me...

I... Your victory is what matters most to 
me

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Considering the necessary training 
environment, experience, and everything 
else... it felt like there was only one 
best choice to arrive at."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's no guarantee we'll win by leaving 
it to him. However... our chances will 
rise. For Orfevre, that is the best path.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: —I want to entrust you to them.
—I want to entrust you to them.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...And you are certain this is the course 
we must take?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Quietly... so very quietly, a temporary 
farewell with Orfevre was decided.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or. If you don't mind, I would also like 
to speak with Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Dear Sister.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...Forgive me. I overstepped my bounds."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ... I shall permit that choice.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Either way, the outcome will be the exact 
same...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: My victory —is an absolute certainty.
